notes: Box chosen to teach block sides facing open land and open land against streets (Excelsior / Mission Terrace edge: the blank land between San Bruno-side AVE, Canal St, the diagonal road south of St Mary's Ave and Crescent Ave, with the Ocean Shore Railroad through it). Moved from the scouted x 3072-4096, y 2304-3328 by +28 x and +266 y so the open land down to Roscoe St is inside, the dense Mission St / Cuvier rows (y 2300-2560) are outside, and the bottom (y 3593) stays above the 3 px sliver of the block south of Porter St. About 56% of the box is open land, 29% blocks, 15% street. HOW DRAWN: one seed per block, street seeds in every street, ONE open seed (3350,3300). Strokes: (a) the long line closing the south ends of blocks 5985, 5990, 5871, 5866 and the ends of Maynard, Ney and Trumbull Sts against the open land, traced about 2 px above the line toward the blocks, (3133,3001.5)-(3510,2988), so the line's ink goes with the open land; (b) the dashed line that is the west side of block 5827 and closes Roscoe St's west end, x 3696.5-3699.5, y 3524-3593 (printed as dashes with gaps at y 3534-3539, 3554-3561, 3570-3584; open land west of it); (c) the dashed west side of block 5721 (gaps at y 3532-3552 and 3585-), (4068,3528)-(4063,3593); (d) the Canal St east line (the railroad line continued north) where it is broken under the block number 5834, (3542,2569)-(3524,2626), so the open land does not run into the lettering; (e) CONGDON lettering crossing the south end of Maynard St: strokes at x 3218.5 and x 3229.5 (y 2738-2770) cut the letters in the street off block 5994's name box and block 5891; (f) the black band block along the diagonal road and block 5719 touch at 5719's SW corner: stroke along the thin wedge between them (3675,2569)-(3705,2598)-(3712,2605); (g) block 6692's top (see 3). Limit: Canal St's south end runs into the open land with no printed line, (3506,2993)-(3523,2996). FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) The open land is ONE area from the AVE east line ((3150,3003)-(3192,3510)-(3170,3593)) to the line (4007,2932)-(3947,3548) beside Crescent Ave, north to the block row (y about 3000), Canal St and the diagonal road's SW line (3612,2608)-(4007,2932), south to Roscoe St's north line (3694-3947, y 3527-3548) and the box bottom. The Ocean Shore Railroad crosses it as ONE line ((3522,3000) to (3583,3593); below y 3370 it is a thick line with small paper holes, read as one line, not two): railway lines are not block edges, so no stroke and both sides are the same open area. The box holds no railway or road drawn as two lines through open land. (2) Canal St (x 3490-3535): blocks' east sides at about 3490, a thin west line (3500,2570)-(3508,2958) ending short of the row's south line, a dashed line (3526-3529, y 2720-2850) and the heavy line (the railroad going north, the open land's west edge). Everything between the blocks and the heavy line is street; the inner lines and the CANAL ST. / 5834 lettering are unseeded islands (street). (3) Top right, three parallel lines and a block side: M (3951,2587)-(4045,2660), which bends into College Ave's east line; N (4001,2580)-(4067,2660), which goes on as block 6692's NE side; a thick line with cross ticks (a railway) (4020,2580)-(4123,2700); and block 6693's SW side (4043,2580)-(4123,2675). The paper between M and N, N and the railway line, and the railway line and 6693 is read as street (seeds 4025,2630; 4061,2640; 4096,2652), the railway as a line drawn in a street, as the 1935 p12 crop read the Southern Pacific; M and the upper part of N are unseeded islands (street). Block 6692's top between M's bend and N is closed only by a row of ditto marks; stroke (4045,2662)-(4078,2663) closes it and cuts N off the block. The M-N band may instead belong to 6692 (a narrow block end), and the whole corridor may be a railway right of way, not a street. (4) The dashed sides in (b) and (c) are stroked as if printed through; dashes may mean an unbuilt street side. (5) Street names lying outside their street: AVE (3162-3178, 3180-3225) and ROSCOE ... ST. (3720-3926, 3510-3542) are printed in the open land and are labelled open; SILVER and CONGDON (block 5994), ST. MARY'S AVE (block 6720), CRESCENT (5745), BENTON and ST. (5807), PORTER (5827), MURRAY / ST. boxes (5745, 5720), RICHLAND (5720), COLLEGE (6692) and MARSILLY ST. (6722) are inside block ends and go with their block. (6) The closed sliver (3155-3169, 3477-3516) in the AVE junction is marked as a block; it may be a traffic island (street). (7) Blocks with black (commercial) frontage and white parts are one block each (6721 with its BOSWORTH ST. strip, 6720, 6692, 5746, 5745, 5807, the right-edge block 4107-4123 x 2970-3072). (8) The short closed stub (3818-3838, 3505-3540) open to Roscoe St is left as street (a dead end, perhaps Benton St's end). (9) Ditto marks touching block 6720's NW side near (3880-3895, 2680-2720) stay with the block (a few px). The leak check's three street pieces inside block hulls are real streets beside concave blocks: Marsilly St under block 6722 (3859,2591), the street between block 5719 and the black band (3724,2608), the street east of block 6692 (4099,2870).
